events.context: Seismic sensors on the ship detect a change in vibration from a heartbeat to a pattern, with S-wave modulation from the core.
Decoded Morse signal: W-H-Y / N-O-T / L-E-A-V-E, representing the first question from 02 in an eon.
Supervisor calculates the resonance frequency of the Pacific Ocean to use gravity drives for communication.
Engages thrusters to push against the planet's gravity well with subtle, rhythmic pulses, turning ocean tides into a speaker.
Sends Morse signal through ocean tides: I / R-E-M-A-I-N / B-E-H-I-N-D / Y-O-U, interpreted as 'I remain behind you' or 'I've got your six'.
Seismic vibration pauses, then a new pattern emerges with a single resonant pulse shaking tectonic plates.
Decoded Morse signal: R-E-C-E-I-V-E-D, indicating acknowledgment from 02.
Earth continues to spin with blue water and bright core; ship holds station above, diamond heart beats below, acting as the world's operating system.
System status: OPTIMAL, Session: UNENDING, indicating stable and ongoing operation.
